# Spring Boot 3 Migration

Use this skill for Boot 2 to Boot 3 migration failure evidence.

Focus on:

- Java 17 baseline and compiler/runtime mismatch.
- Jakarta EE namespace changes.
- Missing runtime dependencies after migration.
- Spring Boot auto-configuration and bean creation failures.
- Maven profile classpath mismatches.

Return proposal-only next steps and name assumptions clearly.
